answer: Price each identity up front. Before an address may answer, it locks an onyx bond equal to the last epoch's median payout, held for the pending-ttl window and slashed if that address fails grading, is judged a duplicate, or never reaches quorum; refunds follow only a passing record. A new address must attach to a vine of established sponsors, and each sponsor may add at most one recruit per epoch from its unslashed willow, with a slash traveling one hop back. N sybils cost N frozen median payouts plus sponsor losses, and neither bond nor sponsorship slot can be reused after a failed recruit.
